source: Wiki 2025 Christmas event: 10 December 2025 to 7 January 2026. The 2026 window re-runs it on the same calendar dates.
Wiki 2026 Easter event: 25 March to 23 April 2026. Easter's date moves each year, so no later window is guessed.

Wiki 25th Anniversary event (OSRS's 13th birthday): 18 February to 4 March 2026. Times are the release and removal update caches (openrs2 2455 and 2485). A one-off anniversary, so no later window is guessed.
Wiki 2025 Halloween event: 15 October to 5 November 2025; times are the OpenRS2 cache timestamps bracketing the event (caches 2327 and 2349). The 2026 window re-runs it on the same calendar dates.
